caption: The drawing depicts a wooden writing desk with four straight, tapered legs. The desk is predominantly brown with lighter golden yellow decorative inlays and marquetry on the legs, apron, and front panels. The back and sides of the desk rise vertically to form a partial enclosure, curving outward at the top corners on both the left and right ends. Each end has a rectangular panel with a central circular design featuring a knob in the middle, surrounded by a shell-like pattern. The main writing surface is light gray, and there is an empty rectangular compartment above the surface, backed by a wooden panel. The desk features symmetrical geometric motifs and contrasting wood tones throughout its structure. The drawing is signed in the lower left corner.
title: Mixing Table
